'''2023 Online Championship Series Playoffs''' was the Players Committee OCS playoff on GEMP, October–November 2023. [[Justin Desai]] defeated [[Timo Dusel]] in the Finals.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-10-2023-online-championship-series-playoffs/</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-ocs-wrap-desai-wins-incredible-fourth-title/ 2023 OCS Wrap - Desai Wins Incredible Fourth Title], starwarsccg.org (6 December 2023). Preserved copy: [https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2023-ocs-wrap-desai-wins-incredible-fourth-title.html swccg.com snapshot]</ref>
